confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are based on aggregated cost-of-living sites found by web search: livingcost.org (https://livingcost.org/cost/japan/matsuyama), nomad.watch (https://nomad.watch/cities/JP/matsuyama/costs) and citycost.org (https://citycost.org/matsuyama/). Those sites gave a cappuccino at about $2.9-4, a pub beer at $2.8-5, a cheap meal at $6-8 and dinner for two at about $33. These are crowdsourced figures, and the sources disagree, especially on pub drinks. The citycost budget-meal figure looked too low and was set aside. Draft beer was set at about 550 JPY, the usual izakaya price. Cocktail and wine prices were weakly sourced, so they were set from their usual local relationship to beer: an izakaya or bar cocktail at about 800 JPY and a glass of house wine at about 650 JPY. I did not search accommodation prices. Those anchors are general-knowledge estimates for a mid-sized regional Japanese city during the July summer season. Only one search was used for prices, so the drink anchors carry the most uncertainty. The FX rate is the RBA figure for 18 November 2026, found by web search and shown at https://www.rba.gov.au/statistics/frequency/exchange-rates.html.
comparable_city_reasoning: Prices were benchmarked against regional Japanese cities of a similar size, such as Okayama, Takamatsu and Kochi. These cities are cheaper than Tokyo or Osaka for meals and lodging, and drink prices follow standard Japanese izakaya and chain-café prices.
